title: UV Crosslinking of Suspension Cells for eCLIP
author: Eric Van Nostrand
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z62f9ge
materials: Gently resuspend until the sample is homogeneous
Pool all cells per biosample (if multiple plates)

steps.title: Prepare cells on culture plate
steps.instruction: Aliquot at most 60×10^6 cells (re-suspended in 1x DPBS) in at least 3 mL total volume to a standard 10cm tissue culture grade plate, ensuring cells are evenly dispersed and the plate is fully covered.

steps.title: Prepare plate for cross-linking
steps.instruction: Place the tissue culture plate on leveled ice or a cooling block pre-chilled to 4°C.

steps.title: Perform UV cross-linking
steps.instruction: Cross-link the cells using 254-nm UV light with an energy setting of 400 mJoules/cm² (which may be displayed as 4000 on some devices).

substeps.instruction: Remove the tissue culture plate lid.
Place the plate (with ice or cooling block) into the UV cross-linker, ensuring the plate is leveled.

steps.title: Collect cross-linked cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the cells from the plate to a 50 mL conical tube.

substeps.instruction: Wash the plate once with 7mL of 1x DPBS and add the wash to the same 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Concentrate and wash cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 50 mL conical tube at 200g for 5 minutes at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet(s) in 25 mL of 1x DPBS at room temperature.

steps.title: Final pelleting and counting
steps.instruction: Spin down the remaining sample in the 50 mL conical tube(s) at 200g for 5 minutes at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Count cell concentration using an automated cell counter or hemocytometer, ensuring cells are re-suspended well before counting.

steps.title: Prepare cells for flash freezing
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells to a concentration of no more than 20×10^6 cells per mL.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the desired amount (typically 1mL of 20×10^6 cells per mL) into 1.5 mL Eppendorf Safe-Lock Tubes or equivalent.

steps.title: Flash freeze and store
steps.instruction: Freeze the cells by submerging the epi-tubes completely in liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Wait until frozen (at least thirty seconds).
Remove from liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C.
